question: Which directions in the declared four-parameter two-layer EBM are locally distinguishable from equilibrium temperatures alone versus the existing held-out transient forcing histories, when parameter coordinates and numerical derivative policy are fixed in advance?
hypothesis: Equilibrium surface/deep temperatures depend only on climate feedback, so the equilibrium log-parameter sensitivity matrix has rank one with the two heat capacities and ocean-exchange coefficient exactly invisible. The same four-parameter sensitivity under the fixed held-out step, ramp, overshoot/reversal, and sign-reversal protocols is full column rank at the reference point, with stable centered finite differences at the preregistered step and half-step.

datasets.quality_control_policy: all four reference parameters are finite and positive; values are literature-fixed fixture inputs rather than estimates produced by this experiment
protocol identities, forcing histories, and sampling density are immutable experiment inputs

datasets.time_domain: equilibrium probes plus the immutable transient protocol set
datasets.quality_control_policy: parameter ordering, perturbation step, convergence refinement, equilibrium forcing probes, transient protocol identities, and machine-scaled rank rule are fixed before execution

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: centered log-parameter sensitivity of equilibrium surface/deep temperatures over the fixed equilibrium forcing probes
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: all four parameter columns and all equilibrium probes are required

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: centered log-parameter sensitivity of both temperature states across all samples of the fixed held-out transient forcing protocols
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: all four parameter columns and every declared transient protocol sample are required

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: transient local sensitivity rank minus equilibrium local sensitivity rank

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: number of equilibrium log-parameter sensitivity columns that are exactly zero under the declared model equations
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: all four equilibrium sensitivity columns are required

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: largest divided by smallest singular value of the full-rank transient log-parameter sensitivity matrix
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: reported only when transient sensitivity is full column rank

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: relative Frobenius disagreement between the preregistered centered log-parameter finite-difference step and its fixed half-step refinement for equilibrium sensitivities
relative Frobenius disagreement between the preregistered centered log-parameter finite-difference step and its fixed half-step refinement for transient sensitivities

negative_controls: equilibrium sensitivity must leave surface heat capacity, deep heat capacity, and ocean exchange exactly invisible rather than assigning them small regularized effects
the same reference parameter point and parameter ordering are used for equilibrium and transient analyses
transient excitation uses only the existing immutable held-out step, ramp, overshoot/reversal, and sign-reversal forcing protocols
parameter perturbations are multiplicative in fixed log coordinates and use both the preregistered finite-difference step and fixed half-step refinement
no optimizer, prior, posterior, parameter fit, target-informed rescaling, or global-identifiability claim is introduced
falsifiers: equilibrium local sensitivity rank differs from one or any of the three structurally absent equilibrium parameter columns becomes nonzero
transient local sensitivity fails to span all four declared parameter directions at the reference point
the inferred rank changes under the fixed half-step derivative refinement
the derivative consistency diagnostic exceeds its declared numerical tolerance
full transient local rank is reported as global identifiability, observational calibration, or evidence about real-climate parameter recoverability
split_policy: No parameter fitting occurs. The transient observation design reuses the immutable held-out forcing protocols as fixed excitation histories; equilibrium and transient sensitivity matrices are evaluated at the same literature-fixed reference parameter point.
preprocessing: Use both temperature-state coordinates in kelvin anomaly. Parameter derivatives are taken with respect to log parameters, avoiding unit-dependent parameter-column scaling without learning a normalization from outputs.
stopping_rule: Report equilibrium and transient ranks, nullities, singular values, condition semantics, exact zero equilibrium columns, and derivative-step consistency. Do not replace a rank-deficient design with regularization or collapse the diagnostics into one aggregate identifiability score.
multiple_comparison_policy: The four parameter identities, three equilibrium forcing probes, four transient protocols, and two derivative steps are fixed by this experiment version.
